subject: Taxes
title: The American Revolution's Tax Origins
description: One-minute skill: The American Revolution's Tax Origins.

hook.text: Britain spent £70 million defending the colonies during the French and Indian War.

buildup.text: The Sugar Act, Stamp Act, and Townshend Acts each imposed taxes without colonial representation in Parliament.

discovery.text: Colonists didn't object to paying tax—they objected to having no vote.

twist.text: The total taxes were tiny by European standards. Americans paid less tax than any British subject. It was about rights.

climax.text: The American Revolution proved that tax revolts are about legitimacy.

punchline.text: Low taxes, no consent. America revolted over a principle, not a bill.

quiz.question: How did American tax rates compare to British ones before the Revolution?
